intro: Syria has a short Mediterranean coast, mountains, the fertile Euphrates valley and wide deserts.

chapters.title: Coast to desert
text: A narrow coast is backed by mountains. Inland, Damascus sits at the foot of the Anti-Lebanon range, and Mount Hermon rises on the border. The Euphrates flows across the north-east, with farmland around it.
Much of the centre and south-east is the Syrian Desert, stretching into Iraq and Jordan.

chapters.title: Climate and drought
text: The coast is mild and wet; the interior is hot and dry. A severe drought from 2006 to 2010 drove many farmers to the cities.
